findings.title: Valid leap-boundary midnight remains unavailable after scalar JD conversion
findings.detail: At 2012-07-01, 2015-07-01 and 2017-01-01 UTC midnight (also the recorded 1990 boundary), the binary64 TDB JD is identical to a genuine instant inside the preceding leap second. The scalar adapter converts the shared bin center to a leap second and datetime conversion raises ValueError. AIA acquisition catches this as a provider failure, so an intended valid midnight cannot reach acquisition. Conversely, leap-start bins can have ordinary centers. The retained evidence tests establish representational ambiguity rather than implementing strict ambiguous-bin rejection or documenting rounding; two-part input is absent. This is existing documented residual, not a newly executed reproduction.
